name: devyonq-mc
description: Mission Control v1.7 governance toolkit for Claude Code: the creation, verification, approval, review and closure skills, the gate hooks and the client mc17. The harness runs in DevyonQ: the deterministic half of the methodology (content hashes, the approval-binding projection, field checks, template rendering, the sanctioned-block hash) is a program there, which every skill and hook reaches through the client, signed in once per computer with mc17 login. A recipe copied into a document drifts from the code it describes, so a skill asks the program and computes no figure itself.
